name: Tri*Color ~3-tsu no Hajimari no Ohanashi~
source:
The hero is an average introverted student, like you might find anywhere. 
There are three girls that he likes, but he isn't proactive. Each day he just yearns from afar. 
One is a young lady he sees every day on the train to school. 
One is a younger cute girl who goes to his library. 
One lives next door. She's his neighbor's wife. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE104006.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公是随处可见的普通内向学生。
他喜欢三个女孩，却不主动接近，只是每天从远处渴望着她们。
一人是他每天乘火车上学时都会见到的千金小姐。
一人是常去他家图书馆的可爱年幼女孩。
一人住在隔壁，是邻居家的妻子。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE104006.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
